cohort: 22 children who developed anti-islet cell autoantibodies and 22 matched controls who remained islet cell autoantibody-negative
finding: No differences in gut microbiome composition were found between children who developed anti-islet cell autoantibodies and those who did not, but alterations in microbial interaction networks were observed in those who developed autoantibodies.
mod_finding: The gut microbiome was affected by birth delivery mode.
